name: boss-6
about: Boss Rush: Inflation Titan (a boiler with its gauge in the red). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss06-titan-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
